i.norm: Setting the {@code Void} option (value 2 == {@code Tag.Void}) marks the tag as a void/empty tag. Because {@link Tag#set(int)} returns the same tag instance, and a void tag is also reported as self-closing, both {@code isEmpty()} and {@code isSelfClosing()} become true.
set() mutates and returns the same instance, so this is the same tag object.
